title: Italy Fines Meta Over User Photo Access
excerpt: Italy's antitrust authority has hit Meta with a fine of €805m for failing to properly inform millions of users about photo access.
body_html:
Meta has been handed a fine of €805m by Italy's antitrust authority following accusations that the tech giant failed to properly inform users about how their photos were accessed.

According to the regulatory body, the social media company neglected to notify approximately 20 million users that it held access to their image files.

The penalty addresses transparency issues regarding user data handling on Meta's platforms within the region. Further details on compliance and potential appeals from the company were not immediately detailed in the announcement.
